activation: Start with cpg packages info xz, paths xz and check xz --prefix <prefix>. The source recipe may build at a chosen absolute prefix; binary packages must use exactly the prefix recorded in their manifest.

Add <prefix>/bin before system paths when selecting these tools/scripts. For development, use <prefix>/include and <prefix>/lib, or add <prefix>/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH. No global loader-cache update is required.

NLS messages use <fixed-prefix>/share/locale. Use locale -a to choose an installed non-C UTF-8 locale, for example LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANGUAGE=de. A minimal container needs non-C locale data initialized before NLS checks; C.UTF-8 intentionally suppresses gettext translation. CMake exports liblzma::liblzma from <prefix>/lib/cmake/liblzma.

examples.command: cpg packages info xz --json; cpg packages paths xz; cpg packages check xz --prefix <prefix>

notes: The existing ID has two explicit maintained definitions: package.json for source/binary and original material-profile.json for the complete raw tree. Use the existing pack --definition option; source lock and metadata.catalog are unchanged.

The source recipe leaves upstream source untouched and enables NLS, POSIX threads, every default encoder/decoder/check/filter, all CLI tools, aliases, scripts and basic docs. Both shared and static liblzma are installed; the official CMake/CTest suite runs against the shared build, and installed API probes exercise both forms.

Exact build prerequisites: apt.build-essential=12.10ubuntu1, apt.cmake=3.28.3-1build7, apt.ninja-build=1.11.1-2 and apt.gettext=0.21-14ubuntu2. apt.python3=3.12.3-0ubuntu2.1 supplies checks and the host-reference lzma module. Base Ubuntu POSIX shell/grep/diff/sed are observed when used; this does not certify a complete APT dependency transaction.

The maintainer replay can provide separately extracted exact CMake/Ninja build-only bindings from the existing locked .deb files, recording actual library bindings and unchanged dpkg database. It does not register or pretend to install those packages. Ordinary deployments use the declared exact APT prerequisites.

Binary installation is fixed-prefix because upstream gettext embeds LOCALEDIR. Build directly at the eventual container path, then pack with --prefix set to that exact path and without --relocatable. The package manager must reject a different prefix. Same-prefix reinstall is tested; independent-container deployment is not claimed.

The locked Git source preserves all po4a translation inputs but has no pre-generated translated man pages. This profile builds translated .mo messages and installs source English man pages; po4a/update-po generation remains not_run. No translation source is removed.

Version, fixed CRC vectors, 45 length/preset/check combinations per shared/static linkage, truncated/damaged streams, memory-limit/invalid-preset rejection, raw x86+LZMA2 filters and two-thread encoding are checked. CLI XZ/LZMA-Alone streams are compared with the observed Python lzma reference; installed tools, machine-readable listing, xzgrep/xzdiff and real German help are exercised.

Material installs verify the entire inventory and correctly report executable checks as not_run. Interactive xzmore/xzless pager sessions, translated manual generation, APT/OCI transactions, sanitizer/cross-architecture matrices and benchmark timing remain separate qualifications.

The separate xz-nls functional check selects an actually installed non-C UTF-8 locale and checks German output against the installed .mo catalog. If none exists it outputs initialization_required/nls:not_run and exits 2 with instructions. This framework version records that specific check as failed; xz-functional decompression/API results remain independent. No host locale is changed.
usage.summary: XZ Utils 5.8.4, liblzma shared/static APIs, all upstream CLI tools/scripts and native-language messages; fixed-prefix binary profile preserves upstream NLS behavior, while the complete original source/test material stays available under the same ID.
